title: Processing Fluency and Aesthetic Pleasure: Is Beauty in the Perceiver's Processing Experience?

publication.publisher_or_container: Personality and Social Psychology Review, Vol. 8, No. 4

verification.verification_notes: Bibliographic record and abstract verified via Crossref; theory confirmed: processing ease is experienced as positive affect and misattributed to the stimulus, with fluency raised by repetition, prototypicality, symmetry, and clarity of form.
